Welcome to LeChic

Your local beauty salon in the heart of Chorley, Lancashire. LeChic offers a wide range of treatments designed to help you look and feel your absolute best — from long-lasting gel nails and spa pedicures to targeted skin treatments, brows, lashes and aesthetics.

Every appointment is tailored to you. Skin treatments are matched to your concerns — ageing, congestion, uneven texture — and nail work is finished to last, in a calm, welcoming space where you can truly unwind.

Whether you're booking a full pamper or a quick refresh, the team will talk you through each step, so you leave feeling refreshed, restored and confident.

Beautiful nails, glowing skin — nothing overdone.

Run by Lisa-Marie, since 2013

Lisa-Marie Doheny opened LeChic in 2013 and still does the brows herself. She is a Phibrows microblading artist, and the salon's small team of practitioners and stylists covers everything from advanced facials to nails under one roof.

Clients come back because appointments are unhurried and honest — Lisa-Marie is known for talking people through each step, and for fixing brow work done elsewhere. Reviews call the salon welcoming, and first-timers say they were put at ease.
